correctness.rationale: The bright 4x4 Jacobi matrix has simple nonzero eigenvalues for all positive couplings; dark leaf contrasts give precisely the size-two kernels. Positivity of each projector Schur square reduces all other null vectors to the two-dimensional hub plane. Hub squared-eigenvector profiles coincide iff the first two hub spectral moments agree (necessary) and bright reflection applies (sufficient), giving c=d and pa^2=qb^2. No forgotten eigenvalue coincidence exists because the bright determinant is nonzero. Independent exact commutant tests (86) and direct spectral tests (245) corroborate without replacing the all-size proof.

value.rationale: The condition c=d and pa^2=qb^2 identifies a natural codimension-two spectral-indistinguishability surface, causing one extra null mode even for nonisomorphic sides. Arbitrarily small hub detuning can remove that mode, independent of positive inter-hub coupling, and exact invertibility and kernel criteria hold for every size. This is a motivated coherent-network spectral transition, not a numerical table, textbook normalization or unmotivated slice.
